newsitem.title: JAPAN: Thai rubber shipments to Japan delayed slightly.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber shipments to Japan delayed slightly.

text.p: Shipments of Ribbed Smoked Sheet (RSS) 3 rubber from Thailand to Japan for March delivery have been delayed by up to two weeks, reflecting tight supplies of RSS 3 rubber in Thailand, traders said.
"Although supplies of RSS 4 grade or RSS 5 grade in Thailand appeared ample, supplies of RSS 3 grade were tight since rainfall has affected the quality," a trading house trader said.
"Reflecting the factor, March shipments to Japan have been delayed slightly, probably by one week or two weeks," a trading house trader said.
Winter weather in March in Thailand, when supplies of raw materials fall, was also responsible for a moderate delay of rubber shipments to Japan, traders said.
Japanese traders said, however that the delay of rubber shipments is unlikely to affect the domestic market, given ample domestic rubber stocks in Japan.
"We see little impact so far. The delay of shipments is likely to be solved in the near-future as the winter season ends in April and raw material supplies are increasing," another trader said.
